desc:
A battle royale shooter where you're just trying to be the last one standing.
The twist? The island is overrun with giant mechs that hate you even more than the other players.

--- Daily Updates! ---
Capture mechs to fight for you!
Zones rebalanced with lots of hints now
Giant new map
Ridable cars and mechs

--- Features ---
🔫 Modern shooter weapons including pistols, machineguns, assault rifles, DMRs and shotguns 
🤖 Robots everywhere, and they're MEAN (but drop great loot)
⭐ A huge amount of unlockable gear and cosmetics - gotta 👑WIN to get the good stuff!
🪳 Visit “The Roach” — a giant cargo ship that walks around the map on 8 legs
⚔️ If you die — Gulag 1v1 for a chance to come back. If you die again your team can revive you with kill bounties!
📱 Full mobile support including custom controls
🎥 Choose either Third Person or First Person cameras
